name: Element x Fractal | 1g Live THCA Joint | Kaiju x Fritter Glitter
description: 50% Element Live THCa, 50% top-shelf flower, the Element Live THCa Joint is certified 100% fire. This award-winning infused pre-roll adds the power of Element Live THCa to premium flower, resulting in a high testing joint with percentages commonly 60% or above. This infused joint delivers a smooth burn with a punch, catering to discerning customers seeking a potent experience.
